recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-11337 unless a future Patient Care decision changes how Goal and PlanDefinition divide order set and protocol responsibilities.
issue_request: FHIR-11337 was a Published Patient Care change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked to clarify that Goal is not for defining potential goals in an order set or protocol definition, while Goal is appropriate after an order set is instantiated or assigned to a patient and those potential goals become actual goals.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by git commit bd9f60dbffee762fd2b3e49ee2e07e232b9685a9 on 2016-10-28, whose subject explicitly includes "Goal intro clarification #11337" and whose patch changed source/goal/goal-introduction.xml to the resolved wording.
additional_context: Goal is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. The current source/goal/goal-introduction.xml text still states that Goal is not intended to define potential goals in an order set or protocol definition, points definitions to PlanDefinition, and says Goal is used once an order set is instantiated or assigned to a patient. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no related final decision or community discussion that changes this interpretation.
reconciliation: No source file was changed. The current active source already preserves the FHIR-11337 distinction between order set/protocol definitions and patient-specific instantiations.
